decision: Drop of five grid places (3 penalty points imposed, total of 6 points in the 12 month period)
event_name: Time 20:59 2020 TURKISH GRAND PRIX 12 - 15 November 2020 The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 34) and heard from the driver and team representative, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Failure to respect double yellow flags at turn 3.
offence: Breach of Appendix H, Art. 2.5.5.1.b) and non-compliance with Race Director's Event Notes 7.2
penalty: Drop of five grid places (3 penalty points imposed, total of 6 points in the 12 month period)
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 63 (George Russell), the team representative and have reviewed video, telemetry and marshalling system evidence. Car 63 approached turn 2, which was under double yellow flags for Car 26 (Daniel Kvyat) who was spinning off track on the outside of the turn. While Car 63 made an attempt to slow when encountering the double yellow flags, in the opinion of the stewards he slowed insufficiently and did not have his car under full control as he approached and then passed Car 26. This lack of full control clearly breaches the regulations. The driver also set a meaningful lap time on this lap which in and of itself breaches the requirements set out by the Race Director's notes.
stewards: did not have his car under full control as he approached
in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 63 Failure To Respect Double Yellow Flags
